author: Christopher Klein
title: Star Engine
excerpt: At Cloud Imperium Games working within the Core Technology Group on the Editor and its tools, I created an avenue for developers to speak their minds so that my team and I could translate grievances into bug fixes and deliver improvements to their pipeline tools.

author: Christopher Klein
title: Test Framework
excerpt: Building a lightweight manual test framework for a game studio's QA pipeline — structured test cases, triage criteria, and a shared vocabulary that reduced bug resolution time across three teams.

author: Christopher Klein
title: Design Audit
excerpt: A systematic review of an enterprise product's interface — cataloguing inconsistencies, accessibility gaps, and friction points across 40+ screens to build a prioritised remediation backlog.

author: Christopher Klein
title: Onboarding Redesign
excerpt: Redesigning the first-run experience for an internal tool used by 200+ artists — from discovery research through prototype validation across five iterative test rounds.

author: Christopher Klein
title: Fidgets and Widgets
excerpt: You like thing-a-ma-bobs? I've got 4. A look at the physical and digital objects that quietly occupy my hands and attention while I'm thinking.
imageAlt: A small collection of everyday objects arranged on a wooden surface — a brass bolt, a pocket notebook, a stylus, and a desk timer

author: Christopher Klein
title: On Asking Better Questions
excerpt: A good question is harder to write than a good answer. Notes on how I think about framing questions — in user research, in writing, and in conversation — and why the framing almost always matters more than the answer.

author: Christopher Klein
title: How I Take Notes
excerpt: Not a productivity guide. A description of what I actually do: the tools I use, the habits I've kept, and the ones I've abandoned. Mostly an exercise in noticing what works and not pretending it's a system.
